app_identity.name: Taskly
app_identity.description: A clean, lightweight personal task-management single-page dashboard designed for fast, frictionless local-only task creation, filtering, and tracking.

design_archetype.description: High readability, structured geometry, generous touch targets, subtle borders, and color-coded priority indicators over a crisp warm slate background.

layout_and_structure.container: max-w-2xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-8 sm:py-12 min-h-screen flex flex-col justify-between

header.container: flex items-center justify-between pb-6 mb-6 border-b border-slate-200/80
header.logo: flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-bold text-slate-900
header.badge: bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold border border-slate-200

task_input_section.container: bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-sm mb-6 space-y-4 sm:space-y-0 sm:flex sm:items-center sm:gap-3
task_input_section.input: w-full bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 focus:border-slate-400 focus:bg-white focus:outline-none rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 transition-all
task_input_section.priority_select: min-w-[120px] bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2.5 text-sm text-slate-700 font-medium focus:outline-none focus:border-slate-400
task_input_section.add_button: w-full sm:w-auto min-w-[110px] bg-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-800 text-white font-medium px-5 py-2.5 rounded-xl text-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-sm active:scale-[0.98]

filter_and_counter_bar.container: flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 mb-4 px-1
filter_and_counter_bar.tabs_group: flex items-center p-1 bg-slate-100/80 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/60 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600
filter_and_counter_bar.tab_item: px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer select-none
filter_and_counter_bar.counter: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-slate-500 flex items-center gap-1.5

task_list.item_card: group flex items-center justify-between gap-3 p-3.5 sm:p-4 bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200/80 shadow-xs hover:border-slate-300 transition-all transform hover:-translate-y-0.5
task_list.checkbox: h-5 w-5 rounded-md border-2 border-slate-300 text-slate-900 focus:ring-slate-900 transition-colors cursor-pointer
task_list.title: text-sm sm:text-base text-slate-800 font-medium break-words leading-snug truncate sm:whitespace-normal
task_list.delete_btn: opacity-80 group-hover:opacity-100 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 p-2 rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer

layout_and_structure.sorting_rule: Completed tasks sort automatically to the bottom of the task list.

empty_states.container: py-12 px-4 text-center bg-white/60 border border-dashed border-slate-200 rounded-2xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-3
empty_states.title: text-base font-semibold text-slate-800

states.no_tasks: Your list is empty. Add your first task above!
states.no_active: All caught up! No active tasks pending.
states.no_completed: No completed tasks yet. Finish a task to see it here.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a single-page local React dashboard using Javascript (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind CSS and lucide-react icons.
Persist tasks in localStorage using key 'taskly_tasks_v1'. Ensure tasks load cleanly on initial render.
Validate inputs: trimmed strings, no empty titles, limit title length to 100 characters max with remaining character hint if approaching limit.
Priority selector options: Low, Medium, High. Default to 'Medium'.
Filter tabs: All, Active, Completed. Filters MUST NOT modify tasks in storage.
Completed tasks MUST display a line-through strikethrough effect and automatically sort below active tasks.
Display remaining active tasks counter prominently in the filter bar (e.g. '3 tasks left').
Render friendly empty states for: (1) no tasks total, (2) no active tasks, (3) no completed tasks.
Add toast notification via Sonner when task is added, completed, or deleted.
Include all required data-testid attributes specified in testing_attributes for all interactive elements.
Ensure total mobile responsiveness with non-overflowing text and tap-friendly touch targets.
